newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight, one-week rates on pound ease.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight, one-week rates on pound ease.

text.p: Egyptian pound overnight interbank rates declined on Wednesday to between 10 and 10 1/4 percent from 10 1/4 and 10 3/8 percent on Tuesday, in a very liquid private sector market, bankers said.
One-week rates on the pound were also lower at 10 1/8 and 10 1/4 percent from Tuesday's 10 1/4 and 10 3/8 percent.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
